parameters: While you can technically collect a new set
of shoal items each tide change, they have
been implemented as daily items instead
\bOh, hey! Shoal Salt and Shoal Shells!\nAnd enough of them, too!
\bWould you like me to make you\na Shell Bell with them?
\bYou don't have space in your Bag\nif I were to make it for you.
\bYou should make room and come back\nfor a Shell Bell.
\bAll righty, then! I'll make you\na Shell Bell right away.
Turns on SelfSwitch B as indicator that the player
has created at least one Shell Bell
\bHave a Pokémon hold on to that.\nIt'll love it, that's for certain.
\bWhy, the Shell Bell's chime…\nIt's simply sublime!
\bYou can get its ingredients every day,\nso I can make you more.
bOh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a Shell Bell…
\bIf you bring me four each of the\nShoal Salt and Shoal Shells,\nI can make you a Shell Bell…
\bAre you planning on going deep\nin there?
\bHow about bringing me back some\nShoal Salt and Shoal Shells?
\bI can make you something good if\nyou bring me the ingredients.
Slowbronite check and give post-Delta Episode
\bOh, hey! Back for another Shell Bell?
\bI'd be happy to make one for you,\nbut first, I think
\bYou should make room and come back\nfor it.
